errors_found.item: Motif 1 (KLVFFAEDVGSNKGAIIGLM) — biological_role: SwissProt orthologue scan claimed 'hits only in APP orthologues: P05067, P08592 rat, P12023 mouse, P53601, P79307, O73683, P86906, Q28053 - all at the identical Abeta16-35 position'
errors_found.claimed: 8 SwissProt hits, all at the identical Abeta16-35 position (i.e. 687-706)
errors_found.actual: 15 hits, not 8, and three of the eight NAMED accessions do not carry the motif at 687: Q28053 (A4_BOVIN) is a 59-residue Abeta fragment entry with the motif at 22-41; O73683 (A4_DICFU, 780 aa) has it at 697-716; P86906 (A4_FELCA, 40 aa) has it at 16-35. Seven further hits went unlisted: Q28280 CANLF@22, Q60495 CAVPO@687, Q5IS80 PANTR@687, Q28748 RABIT@21, Q95241 SAISC@668, Q28757 SHEEP@21, Q29149 URSMA@21. The primary claim — P05067 687-706 = KLVFFAEDVGSNKGAIIGLM — is exact and verified, as are KLVFF 687-691, KLVFFAE 687-693, GAIIGLM 700-706, Abeta1=Asp672, and TOPO_DOM 18-701 / TRANSMEM 702-722. The directionality verdict is unaffected.

errors_found.item: Motif 7 / unattributed_segments — 'STKTC approximates WNT7A/7B TTKTC (O00755/P56706, pos 205-209)'
errors_found.claimed: TTKTC occurs at residues 205-209 of WNT7A (O00755) and WNT7B (P56706)
errors_found.actual: TTKTC is at 210-214 in both O00755 and P56706. Positions 205-209 in both are VSGSC (the tail of CKCHGVSGSC at 200-209). Real accessions, wrong range, motif absent at the cited range. The substantive point stands — the platform's STKTC matches neither WNT7A/7B TTKTC nor WNT5A/5B SLKTC (P41221 248-252 SLKTC verified) — and WNT3A CWWS (P56704 217-220) and WNT3 CWWA (P56703 220-223) were both verified correct.

errors_found.item: Motif 10 (cationic amphipath) — 'a +9 polycation binds the anionic, aromatic PAS rim (Trp286/Tyr72/Tyr341)', stated immediately after 'AChE (P22303, retrieved)'
errors_found.claimed: Trp286, Tyr72, Tyr341 read as P22303 positions
errors_found.actual: In P22303 UniProt numbering those positions are Val286, Pro72, Asp341. The residues are correct only in mature-chain numbering (SIGNAL 1-31, CHAIN 32-614), i.e. P22303 317=Trp, 103=Tyr, 372=Tyr — all three verified. The report reproduces the dataset's numbers without flagging the convention shift, while elsewhere holding the same dataset to strict UniProt numbering (Occludin Arg220, AMPK Arg67, EAAT2 Thr368). It also failed to note that the same dataset field mixes a second convention: 'AChE CAS (Trp84, Phe330, Tyr121)' is Torpedo numbering (human mature equivalents are Trp86/Phe338/Tyr124).

errors_found.item: Motif 10 — subcellular annotation of acetylcholinesterase
errors_found.claimed: AChE (P22303, retrieved) is annotated Synapse/Secreted/GPI-anchored
errors_found.actual: Canonical P22303 SUBCELLULAR LOCATION reads Synapse; Secreted; Cell membrane, Peripheral membrane protein. GPI-anchor is isoform-specific — feature LIPID 'GPI-anchor amidated glycine' at P22303-2:588 (isoform H). The conclusion (extracellular, therefore the right compartment) is correct either way.

errors_found.item: Motif 8 appears_in — the 31-mer CKCHGMSGSCSTKTCWWGBLCPFRRACPDCH attributed to CogWnt-Fzd-09
errors_found.claimed: CogWnt-Fzd-09 carries the same 31-mer as HippoWnt-FzdAgonist-X4 and AstroZo1-Protect-A3
errors_found.actual: CogWnt-Fzd-09's actual sequence in data/extracted_raw.json is the 40-mer CKCHGMSGSCSTKTCWWGBLCPFRRACPDCHGMSGSCSTK — the 31-mer is a prefix substring, followed by an unreported 9-residue tail GMSGSCSTK. HippoWnt-FzdAgonist-X4 and AstroZo1-Protect-A3 are genuinely byte-identical 31-mers, so the 'redeployed unchanged' claim and the -16.9 vs -16.1 kcal/mol comparison are both verified correct.

errors_found.item: Coverage gap — quoted contact residues the report reproduced but did not check, several of which are fabricated
errors_found.claimed: Report validated contact residues for NTRK2, EAAT2, LC3B, AMPK, ESR2, CHRM1, OCLN, GSK3B and TREM2 (Arg47/Asp87 only), leaving others unexamined
errors_found.actual: All 26 residue identities the report did assert are correct (verified). But five further quoted triads contain fabrications the report passed over: TREM2 'Lys112' is Ser112 in Q9NZC2 (the report quoted the triad but declined to validate it); NTRK1 'His312, Leu331' (BasalNgf-TrkA-B3) are Ser312/Glu331 in P04629 and Gly344/Ala363 in mature numbering — wrong in both conventions; GluN2A 'Glu201, Lys210' are Gln201/Phe210 in Q12879 and His223/Ser232 mature — wrong in both; FZD8 'Arg104' is Leu104 in Q9H461 (Phe72, Tyr125, Asp99 all verified correct); PAFR 'His14, Tyr200' are Arg14/Leu200 in P25105, which has no signal peptide so no offset applies (Phe174 verified correct). Verified genuine and also unflagged: TLR4 Arg264/Lys341/Glu439 (O00206), KEAP1 Tyr334/Arg415/Arg483/Ser602 (Q14145), alpha7 nAChR Tyr188/Trp149/Tyr195 (P36544 mature numbering, +22 offset), Abeta Lys28/Asp23 (APP 699/694).

unverifiable: EBI BLASTP E-values quoted throughout (2e-06 for the WNT chimera vs P56703/P56704; 9e-05, 3e-05 for pastiche A vs Tenascin-C P24821 / MEGF11 A6BM72 / NOTCH3 Q61982; 0.34, 0.004, 0.008, 0.029 for pastiche B vs MEG11_MOUSE Q80T91 / A6BM72 / TEN4_HUMAN Q6N022; 1.4 for pastiche C; 2.4 for the cationic helix; >=5.0 for WRWYCPWC). I did not re-run EBI BLASTP. The qualitative conclusions these support are independently corroborated: all 38 exact SwissProt substring scans reproduced exactly (every pastiche fragment returns 0 hits across all 575,503 entries, count confirmed), and the Smith-Waterman scores reproduced to the digit (pastiche A self=297, vs NTRK2 Q16620=35, vs NTRK1 P04629=36, BLOSUM62 -11/-1 local).
Web-search negatives ('no published peptide with these sequences' for the cationic helix, GRLVGHPW, ACPCYRGFWR). Absence-of-publication claims are not checkable by sequence retrieval.

The pharmacological directionality premises themselves, as distinct from the sequence and annotation facts underpinning them: that unmodified all-L KLVFF/Abeta16-35 nucleates rather than blocks fibrils; that the BDNF prodomain signals through p75NTR/sortilin with opposite sign to mature BDNF at TrkB; that a free ETGE peptide activates Nrf2 by displacing it from Keap1; that GSK-3beta's pSer9 tail docks the primed-substrate phosphate pocket (Arg96/Arg180/Lys205) rather than the ATP site; that PORCN palmitoleoylation supplies the dominant WNT-FZD CRD binding energy. These are literature propositions. I verified every structural premise they rest on — PROPEP 19-128 vs CHAIN 129-247, kinase domain 56-340 vs disordered 1-53, ATP BINDING 62-70/85, MOTIF 79-82 ETGE, TOPO_DOM/TRANSMEM boundaries, subcellular annotations — and all 16 directionality judgements follow soundly from them, but the phenotypic sign claims were not independently sourced.

The inference that the platform's pLDDT and dG values 'were authored as text rather than computed'. Strongly supported but not directly provable: I confirmed the AstroPafr-Block-A4 sequence field literally contains 'His14-Phe174-Linker-Peptide-Conjugate' alongside dG -15.2, Kd 4.8 nM and pLDDT 92.4, and that the letter B (IUPAC Asx) sits at position 19 of the WNT chimera carried by three entries quoting pLDDT 94.8 / 95.1 / 93.8. Both verified in data/extracted_raw.json.

No SMILES appear anywhere in the report under review, so the RDKit parse/formula check had nothing in scope to run against. The dataset's chemStruct fields carry prose plus bare molecular formulas (e.g. 'Asiatic Acid Ursane Pentacyclic Ring Core (C30H48O5)'), not structures.

errors_found.item: GRIN2A pdb_examples / "representative structure PDB 5TQ2"
errors_found.claimed: 5TQ2 is cited as the representative structure for the human GRIN2A amino-terminal domain, inside a numbering_note that warns 'much of the classic NMDA receptor pharmacology literature and several structures use rat GluN2A' and declares 'I have used human precursor throughout'.
errors_found.actual: 5TQ2 contains NO human GRIN2A. RCSB polymer entities map to Q00959 (NMDE1_RAT, Rattus norvegicus GluN2A, chain B = 34-393) and A0A1L8F5J9 (NMDZ1_XENLA, Xenopus laevis GluN1, chain A). Its residue numbering is therefore not on the human Q12879 precursor frame the record declares. This is precisely the species-frame error class the review exists to catch, committed in the same field that warns against it. The other three GRIN2A entries are correct human Q12879 (6IRA, 7EOQ, and 5H8F whose A=401-539 + 661-802 matches the claimed S1S2 boundaries exactly).

errors_found.item: FZD8 safety_flag_from_genetics - cancer association scores
errors_found.claimed: 'Open Targets records literature-level FZD8 associations with breast cancer (0.398) and prostate cancer (0.391).'
errors_found.actual: Neither value is reproducible. Open Targets direct (non-propagated) scores are breast cancer 0.087 and prostate cancer 0.078 - roughly 4.5x lower than claimed. Indirect/propagated scores are 0.864 and 0.805, so the quoted figures match neither setting. The europepmc components (0.64 for both) are correct. These inflated scores are the sole quantitative support offered for the FZD8 Wnt-oncogenicity flag.

errors_found.item: TLR4 safety_flag_from_genetics - sepsis association
errors_found.claimed: 'its highest-scoring Open Targets association is sepsis (0.676)'
errors_found.actual: Wrong on both the value and the superlative. TLR4-Sepsis (HP_0100806) direct score is 0.401 (europepmc 0.958, clinical_precedence 0.611, expression_atlas 0.020). TLR4's actual highest-scoring Open Targets association is major depressive disorder at 0.503 (gwas_credible_sets 0.79) - which the reviewer separately quotes correctly elsewhere in the same record. The infection-liability argument rests on this claim.

errors_found.item: GSK3B safety_flag_from_genetics - hepatocellular carcinoma score
errors_found.claimed: 'GSK3B-hepatocellular carcinoma at 0.633 with a cancer_gene_census contribution of 0.30'
errors_found.actual: Overall score is 0.214, not 0.633 - off by roughly 3x. The cancer_gene_census component IS correct at 0.304, and is a genuine finding (GSK3B has no CGC 'role in cancer' attribute yet still carries a cancer_gene_census evidence contribution here). Only the aggregate score is wrong.

errors_found.item: GRIN2A genetic_evidence_for_cognition - schizophrenia score; GSK3B cancer score
errors_found.claimed: 'schizophrenia 0.708 carrying both common-variant gwas_credible_sets 0.77 and rare-variant gene_burden 0.19'; and 'Open Targets scores GSK3B-cancer at 0.673 (reactome 0.87)'
errors_found.actual: GRIN2A-schizophrenia direct score is 0.588, not 0.708 (indirect is 0.881; neither is 0.708). GSK3B-cancer direct score is 0.557, not 0.673 (indirect 0.905). In both cases every datasource component the reviewer quotes is exactly right (gwas_credible_sets 0.77, gene_burden 0.19, reactome 0.87) - only the aggregates are inflated, so the underlying arguments survive.

errors_found.item: ACHE numbering_note - completeness of the Torpedo/human contamination fix list
errors_found.claimed: 'The same Torpedo/human mix recurs at app.js:248 and app.js:288.'
errors_found.actual: The enumeration is incomplete. Verified in git HEAD, the same defect also appears at app.js:12, app.js:15 and README.md:32. app.js:12 reads 'Trp84, Phe330 (CAS Salt Bridge); Tyr121, Gly117/118 (Hydrogen Bonds); Trp279 (PAS)' and introduces two further Torpedo-numbered identifiers the reviewer never mentions anywhere: Trp279 (human Trp286) and Gly117/118 (human Gly120/121, confirmed from my alignment). Anyone applying the reviewer's fix list would leave three locations and two residue identifiers uncorrected. The reviewer's claim that the working copy was rewritten is accurate (git diff HEAD: 650 insertions, 1033 deletions).

errors_found.item: TLR4 domain_boundaries - LRR repeat count
errors_found.claimed: 'built from 19 annotated LRR repeats running from 55-76 through 545-565'
errors_found.actual: UniProt O00206 annotates 18 REPEAT features, labelled LRR 1 through LRR 18. The quoted endpoints 55-76 (LRR 1) and 545-565 (LRR 18) are both exactly correct; only the count is off by one.

errors_found.item: Cancer Gene Census roles - three incomplete or omitted annotations
errors_found.claimed: NTRK2: 'COSMIC Cancer Gene Census role for NTRK2 is fusion'. NTRK1: 'Cancer Gene Census roles recorded for NTRK1 are oncogene and fusion'. GRIN2A: no CGC status stated.
errors_found.actual: NTRK2 also carries 'oncogene'. NTRK1 also carries 'TSG'. GRIN2A carries CGC roles 'Oncogene' AND 'TSG', which the record omits entirely - notable because the reviewer explicitly reports 'No Cancer Gene Census role' for six other targets (ACHE, CHRNA7, GRIN2B, SLC1A2, NOS3, PTAFR, CHRM1, TLR4, TREM2, FZD8 - all of which I confirmed as genuinely absent), so silence on GRIN2A is a methodological inconsistency rather than a deliberate judgement.

errors_found.item: PDB chain ranges - 1HCF and 6XDS
errors_found.actual: RCSB UniProt alignments give 1HCF chains X,Y = Q16620 284-383 (not 286) and 6XDS chain A = Q9NZC2 17-135 (not 18). All other quoted ranges I checked are exact, including 1WWB X=283-385, all five KEAP1 constructs at 321-609, all five NFE2L2 peptide ranges (2FLU P=69-84, 4IFL P=69-84, 3ZGC C=76-82, 5WFV P=76-84, 7K28 P=77-84), 5UD8 19-130, 5UD7 19-174, all four FZD8 ranges, 5EWJ B/D=31-394, 5H8F 401-539+661-802, 1M9J 67-481, 2IFG 36-382, 3FXI 27-631 and 5CXV 2-218+355-460.

errors_found.item: Unflagged chimeric/mismatched structures in pdb_examples
errors_found.claimed: 5AFH/5AFN listed as CHRNA7 structures; 2Z62/2Z63/2Z66/3UL7 listed as TLR4 structures; 2LZ1 listed under an NFE2L2 record whose domain_of_interest is the Neh2 degron; 1NIW listed under a NOS3 record whose domain_of_interest is the oxygenase domain.
errors_found.actual: 5AFH/5AFN are alpha7/Lymnaea stagnalis AChBP chimeras (P36544 + P58154) with only fragmentary P36544 coverage, not human alpha7 structures. 2Z62/2Z63/2Z66/3UL7 are human TLR4 / hagfish (Eptatretus burgeri) VLRB hybrids (O00206 + Q4G1L2). 2LZ1 is the Q16236 bZIP DNA-binding domain (445-523), not Neh2. 1NIW is the eNOS calmodulin-binding peptide (P29474 492-511) bound to calmodulin, not the oxygenase domain. Given the record's own insistence on declaring organism and construct, these should have been flagged.

errors_found.item: Systematic upward drift in Open Targets aggregate scores
errors_found.claimed: NTRK2 obesity/hyperphagia/DD 0.715; NTRK2 DEE 0.631; TREM2 Nasu-Hakola 0.809; GRIN2A Landau-Kleffner 0.853; GRIN2A Rolandic epilepsy 0.733; GRIN2B DEE27 0.756; NTRK1 HSAN4 0.867; SLC1A2 DEE41 0.766; NOS3 hypertension gene_burden 0.29.
errors_found.actual: Current values are 0.709, 0.606, 0.798, 0.840, 0.715, 0.742, 0.858, 0.763, and essential-hypertension gene_burden 0.27 respectively. Every deviation is in the same upward direction. Individually these are within plausible release drift and every constituent datasource score is exactly right (NFE2L2 IMDDHH 0.766 and GRIN2B ID 0.775 match to three decimals), but the uniform direction alongside the five larger errors above suggests the aggregates were not re-read at the same time as the components.

errors_found.item: NFE2L2 domain_boundaries - understated UniProt annotation; FZD8 Wnt-binding regions
errors_found.claimed: NFE2L2: 'UniProt annotates no DOMAIN over Neh2' and boundaries 'must cite the specific co-crystallised peptide range'; the degron is given as 'ETGE, ~res 77-82'. FZD8: 'Wnt-binding region 147-152'.
errors_found.actual: True that there is no DOMAIN feature, but UniProt Q16236 does directly annotate MOTIF 'ETGE motif' at 79-82 and MOTIF 'DLG motif' at 29-31 - both of the motifs the record names - so the claim that structure is the only source understates what UniProt provides, and the ETGE span is 79-82 rather than ~77-82. FZD8 Q9H461 annotates two Wnt-binding regions, 95-100 and 147-152; only the second is cited.

unverifiable: ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely-Pathogenic sub-counts for GRIN2A (claimed 364), CHRNA7 (claimed 205) and TREM2 - the E-utilities clinical-significance queries were rate-limited. All total record counts I did retrieve match exactly: GRIN2B 1886, GRIN2A 2511, ACHE 100, NTRK1 1827, CHRNA7 459, NFE2L2 463, and the P/LP counts that returned (GRIN2B 333, ACHE 21, NTRK1 227, NFE2L2 35) all match. ClinVar counts drift continuously and should be treated as timestamped.

Whether the specific platform binding-site residues are genuine contact residues, as opposed to merely falling inside the stated domain. I confirmed the arithmetic containment claims (NTRK2 Asp298/Val312/Glu319/Leu333/Tyr342 inside 295-365; KEAP1 Tyr334/Arg415/Arg483/Ser602 inside 327-611; FZD8 Phe72 inside the 71-78 lipid groove; GSK3B Val135/Asp133/Lys85 consistent with the ATP pocket; TLR4 Arg264/Lys341/Glu439 inside the LRR ectodomain) but did not re-derive contact status from coordinates. The reviewer's own hedging on GRIN2A Glu201/Lys210, PTAFR Tyr200/Phe174, CHRM1 Trp164 and SLC1A2 Thr368/Lys490 is appropriate; I confirmed independently that PTAFR His14 does lie in TOPO_DOM 1-16 outside the 7TM bundle, and that SLC1A2 Thr368 and Lys490 are indeed absent from UniProt's annotated substrate/Na+ coordination set (362-364, 393, 395, 397, 401, 442-446, 475, 482, 486, all confirmed).

The COSMIC Cancer Gene Census percentage figures quoted for NTRK2 (3.1% juvenile pilocytic astrocytoma, 3.5% paediatric diffuse midline glioma, 0.19% and 0.24% of tumours). I confirmed all four verbatim through Open Targets' mirrored CGC annotation, but could not check them against COSMIC directly, which requires authentication.

The mechanistic characterisation of DEE41 SLC1A2 variants as acting 'through gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects rather than simple haploinsufficiency'. The Open Targets association (0.763, five curated sources) is confirmed, but the variant-mechanism claim was not traced to primary literature.

Whether the platform's decoy peptide sequence DEETGEFLFQLPQLDEETGEWRWYCPWC is a genuine Nrf2-derived sequence. It does contain ETGE as stated, which is all the reviewer actually claims, but I did not align it against Q16236.

Assignment of Phe295/Phe297 to the CAS rather than the mid-gorge. The reviewer places them in the CAS; some primary literature describes Phe295/Phe297 as mid-gorge acyl-pocket residues. This is a convention difference rather than a resolvable error, and does not affect the numbering correction. By contrast the Tyr124 reassignment IS confirmed: the canonical literature PAS set is exactly Tyr72, Asp74, Tyr124, Trp286, Tyr341, located ~20 A from the catalytic centre, matching the reviewer's corrected string.

The grade label 'contradictory' used for KEAP1 and NFE2L2 is an editorial construct, not a term on any standard genetic-support scale. The underlying evidence is fully confirmed (KEAP1 CGC role TSG with the verbatim 'LOF mutations reduce the affinity to Nrf2' and recurrent R470C annotations, intOGen driver scores 0.84 lung adenocarcinoma / 0.73 NSCLC / 0.57 HCC; NFE2L2 CGC oncogene with both verbatim KEAP1-interface annotations, IMDDHH at 0.766 with uniprot_variants 0.89 / genomics_england 0.87 / eva 0.82 / gene2phenotype 0.61, and the AOP-Wiki 'Increased, Liver Steatosis' liability on activation), so the reasoning is sound; only the label is non-standard.
